_readme: Skills, tags, status effects and skill trees. Percentages are fractions (0.8 = 80%). Ranges are in tiles (Euclidean: 1 = the 4 neighbours, 1.5 includes diagonals). Cooldown N = usable again N turns after the turn it was used (1 = once per turn). Keys starting with _ are comments. The game checks this file on load and reports the exact field if something is wrong.

_fields.description: One plain sentence on what the skill does. The numbers (damage, range, costs, statuses) are listed under it in game, generated from the data, so leave them out of the text.
_fields.target: unit (aim at a tile, affects the unit there) | ground (aim at a tile, places a zone there; needs "zone") | self | line (aim at a tile, hits the first unit on the straight path to it) | cone (overwatch) | emptyTile | move (Dash: walk to a reachable tile)
_fields.ap: Action points. Every unit has 2 AP a turn: a movement AP and an action AP. 0 = free action | 1 = uses the movement AP if it's still unspent (otherwise the action AP); the turn goes on while AP remain | 2 = uses both AP; the turn goes on (free actions are still allowed) | "end" (the default) = uses all remaining AP and ends the unit's turn. Free-tagged skills default to 0.
_fields.mana: Mana spent on use (default 0). Mana doesn't come back during a battle.
_fields.affects: enemy | ally | any (friend and foe; for 'unit' skills this includes yourself)
_fields.hits: list of hits, each { pAtk, mAtk, def, missingHp } as fractions
_fields.los: sight = line of sight (rocks block) | fire = line of fire (rocks AND units block; kept for future skills). Omit for none.
_fields.rangeScale: for 'movement' skills: range in tiles = floor(rangeScale x Movement / movementCosts.grass)
_fields.applyStatus: list of { status, turns, stacks }. Statuses with "decay": true (Burn, Chilled) take only stacks: they lose one stack each turn instead of lasting a number of turns.
_fields.decay: Statuses: lose one stack each time they tick (start or end of the unit's turn) and end at 0 stacks, instead of lasting a set number of turns. Their stacks are turns left (and count toward maxStacks), not strength: 2 stacks hit as hard as 1.
_fields.mitigated: Statuses with damage (damagePctMaxHpPerStack, instantDamagePctMaxHp): reduced by Defense and absorbed by shields, like a hit. Without it the damage ignores both.
_fields.level: Skill-tree skills: the character level needed to learn it (default 1).
_fields.modes: A weapon basic attack with switchable modes (the Bow): list of skill ids, the first is the default. The unit's current mode decides which one is used; Switch Mode cycles them. Overwatch and 'weapon' skills follow the current mode.
_fields.modeName: Short name of a mode skill (Direct, Indirect, Melee)
_fields.weaponRange: Range as a multiple of the weapon's range (equipment.json "range"), e.g. 1.5 = Weapon Range x 1.5
_fields.basicMode: For 'basicAttack' skills: use the weapon mode with this tag (e.g. "melee") instead of the current one
_fields.switchMode: true = cycles the user's weapon to its next mode
_fields.damageTypes: Each hit is split by what it scales with: P.Atk, Def and missing HP are Physical damage, M.Atk is Magical damage. Tag skills 'physical' / 'magical' to match (a test checks it).
_fields.basicAttack: Hit with the user's weapon basic attack this many times (instead of 'hits'). Used by Double Strike and Circle Swing.
_fields.missingHpBonus: { max, atHealth }: the skill's hits are multiplied by up to `max`, growing smoothly from 1x at full Health to `max` at `atHealth` of max Health and below (Execute: 2x at 25%). Uses the target's Health before the hit; weapon on-hit effects (Arcane Weapon) aren't multiplied.
_fields.basicAttackDamage: For 'basicAttack' skills: damage multiplier per swing, one per basic attack (Double Strike: [1, 0.5] = full, then half). Omit for full damage.
_fields.engageWithin: Engage the target (as the Engage tag does) only if it is within this many tiles (Basic Attack: 1.5 = adjacent, diagonals included). Don't combine with the engage tag.
_fields.selfStatus: list of { status, turns } applied to the user before the skill resolves (never resisted)
_fields.toggleStatus: A status with "toggle": true. Using the skill switches it on (paying the skill's mana) or, if it's already on, off (free). Toggle statuses can set manaPerTurn (paid at the start of each of the unit's turns), weaponOnHit { pAtk, mAtk } (an extra hit on each target of a weapon attack: basic attacks, Overwatch, opportunity attacks, 'weapon' skills) and manaPerHit (paid per extra hit). Out of mana, the status switches off.
_fields.instantDamagePctMaxHp: Statuses: applying it deals this share of max Health at once, ignoring Defense and shields, and it isn't kept (Explosion, Burn's overflow).
_fields.recoilIfSurvives: { pAtk, mAtk, ... } damage the user takes (after its own Defense) if the target survives the hits
_fields.optional: heal { mAtk }, shield { maxHpPct and/or mAtk, turns }, knockback (tiles), cleanse, teleport, charge (with teleport: appear next to the target instead of dashing), aoeRadius (a 'weapon' self skill without one uses the weapon's range), cone { angle, radius, interrupt, los } (radius defaults to the skill's range, so 'weapon' cones reach as far as the weapon; a cone skill without hits attacks with the user's basic attack)
_fields.zone: For target 'ground': { radius (1.5 = 3x3), turns (the caster's team's turns it lasts), hit { pAtk, mAtk } per hit, applyStatus per hit, endTurnHits }. Each tile a unit enters inside it = 1 hit; ending a turn inside = endTurnHits hits. Hits everyone, allies included.
_fields.basicSkills: abilities every Adventurer has on top of weapon and tree skills

melee.name: Melee
melee.description: Close-range attack. No line of sight needed.

engage.name: Engage
engage.description: On hit, you and the target become engaged (unless the target is already engaged). Engaged units can't move (but can Charge each other), can only attack each other (area attacks just need to hit the opponent), and can only heal or cleanse themselves. Breaking away (disengaging, or being knocked back) gives the opponent a free basic attack.

projectile.name: Projectile
projectile.description: Needs a clear line to the target: line of sight (rocks block) or line of fire (rocks and units block).

indirect.name: Indirect
indirect.description: Arcs over obstacles. No line of sight needed.

knockback.name: Knockback
knockback.description: Pushes targets away. Walls and other units stop the push. A unit pushed out of an engagement takes a free basic attack from its opponent.

reaction.name: Reaction
reaction.description: Sets a watch that triggers during the enemy's turn when they move into it. Lasts until your next turn.

disengage.name: Disengage
disengage.description: Usable while engaged, even on units other than your opponent. Using it ends your engagement with no free attack for your opponent.

physical.name: Physical
physical.description: Deals Physical damage (from P.Atk, Def or missing Health).

stealth.name: Stealth
stealth.description: Makes you Stealthed: enemies can't target you directly.

teleport.name: Teleport
teleport.description: Moves you instantly, ignoring terrain and units in the way.

movement.name: Movement
movement.description: Range scales with your Movement: every 4 Movement (one grass tile) = 1 tile, rounded down. Slow shortens it.

weapon.name: Weapon
weapon.description: Uses your weapon's basic-attack range and line rules. Unusable while your weapon is disabled.

free.name: Free Action
free.description: Costs 0 AP. Usable any time until the unit's turn ends.

debuff.name: Debuff
debuff.description: Applies a harmful effect that Cleanse can remove.

monster.name: Monster
monster.description: A natural attack used by monsters.

support.name: Support
support.description: Restores or protects. Works only on your own side (yourself included).

toggle.name: Toggle
toggle.description: Switches an effect on, paying its mana cost. It stays on, costing mana every turn, until you use it again (free) or run out of mana.

passive.name: Passive
passive.description: Always in effect once learned. It isn't used from the skill bar.

burn.name: Burn
burn.description: At the end of each turn: take 5% of max Health (reduced by Defense, absorbed by shields), then lose a stack. Each stack is a turn; more stacks last longer but don't burn harder. Up to 2 stacks; a 3rd stack Explodes instead.

explosion.name: Explosion
explosion.description: Burn's 3rd stack: removes Burn and deals 15% of max Health at once (reduced by Defense, absorbed by shields). The ground under it catches fire for 2 turns.

arcane_weapon.name: Arcane Weapon
arcane_weapon.description: Weapon attacks deal an extra 50% M.Atk (Magical) each time they hit, for 10 mana each (Double Strike: twice; Circle Swing: once per target). No cost while it is on and unused. Switches off when there is no mana left to pay for a hit. A weapon holds one enchantment at a time.

fire_weapon.name: Fire Weapon
fire_weapon.description: Weapon attacks deal an extra 20% M.Atk (Magical) and add a stack of Burn each time they hit, for 10 mana each. Switches off when there is no mana left to pay for a hit. A weapon holds one enchantment at a time.

ice_weapon.name: Ice Weapon
ice_weapon.description: Weapon attacks deal an extra 20% M.Atk (Magical) and add a stack of Chilled each time they hit, for 10 mana each. Switches off when there is no mana left to pay for a hit. A weapon holds one enchantment at a time.

chilled.name: Chilled
chilled.description: -25% Movement; loses a stack at the end of each turn. Each stack is a turn; more stacks last longer but don't slow more. Up to 2 stacks; a 3rd stack Freezes the unit instead.

slow.name: Slow
slow.description: -25% Movement. Doesn't stack and can't Freeze; getting slowed again only renews it.

frozen.name: Frozen
frozen.description: Chilled's 3rd stack: can't move for one turn. It loses its movement AP, and Frozen wears off at the end of that turn.

stealth.name: Stealthed
stealth.description: Enemies can't target you directly or trigger overwatch on you; area attacks still hit. Ends early if you attack.

protected.name: Protected
protected.description: +Defense equal to 25% of the caster's M.Atk.

revealed.name: Revealed
revealed.description: Seen by the other side through fog of war, and can't be Stealthed (Stealth is removed). Can't be resisted.

unyielding.name: Unyielding
unyielding.description: Immune to debuffs (status effects) until the start of your next turn.

staggered.name: Staggered
staggered.description: Loses 1 AP at the start of its next turn: the movement AP if it still has it.

quick_cast.name: Quick Cast
quick_cast.description: Your next Mage spell this turn that costs 2 AP or ends your turn costs 1 AP instead. Using Quick Cast again cancels it, refunding its mana and cooldown; it also switches off (refunded) at the end of your turn if unused.

in_the_zone.name: In the Zone
in_the_zone.description: Your basic attacks cost no AP and ignore their cooldown, one stack per attack.

poison.name: Poison
poison.description: Lose 3% of max Health per stack at the start of each turn. Ignores Defense and shields.

basic_attack.name: Basic Attack
basic_attack.description: Strike an enemy within your weapon's range. An adjacent target becomes engaged.

shield_slam.name: Shield Slam
shield_slam.description: Slam an enemy within your weapon's range with your shield.

quick_attack.name: Quick Attack
quick_attack.description: A fast weaker basic attack that leaves you an action.

bow_attack.name: Basic Attack
bow_attack.description: Attacks based on the bow's mode.

direct_shot.name: Direct Shot
direct_shot.description: Shoot an enemy you can see.

indirect_shot.name: Indirect Shot
indirect_shot.description: Lob an arrow that arcs over obstacles.

bow_strike.name: Bow Strike
bow_strike.description: Strike an adjacent enemy with the bow. A bow user that is engaged always attacks this way.

switch_mode.name: Switch Mode
switch_mode.description: Cycle the bow's mode: Direct, then Indirect, then Melee, then back to Direct. The bow keeps its mode between battles.

overwatch.name: Overwatch
overwatch.description: Basic ability. Watch an arc in any direction. The first enemy to move into it takes your basic attack but keeps moving.

dash.name: Dash
dash.description: Basic ability. After your regular move, spend your other AP to move again.

magic_bolt.name: Magic Bolt
magic_bolt.description: Fire a bolt of physical and magical power at an enemy.

arcane_bolt.name: Arcane Bolt
arcane_bolt.description: Fire an arcane bolt at an enemy.

arcane_pulse.name: Arcane Pulse
arcane_pulse.description: Blast an enemy and knock it away.

arcane_weapon.name: Arcane Weapon
arcane_weapon.description: Empower your weapon with arcane force. Use it again to switch it off. Switching it on ends Fire Weapon or Ice Weapon.

spellblade.name: Spellblade
spellblade.description: Your weapon's M.Atk penalty no longer applies to you. A weapon that raises M.Atk still does.

quick_cast.name: Quick Cast
quick_cast.description: Your next Mage spell this turn that would cost 2 AP or end your turn costs 1 AP instead. Use it again to cancel for a refund; it ends with your turn (refunded) if unused.

fire_weapon.name: Fire Weapon
fire_weapon.description: Wreathe your weapon in flame. Use it again to switch it off. Switching it on ends Arcane Weapon or Ice Weapon.

ice_weapon.name: Ice Weapon
ice_weapon.description: Coat your weapon in frost. Use it again to switch it off. Switching it on ends Arcane Weapon or Fire Weapon.

freeze.name: Freeze
freeze.description: Chill an enemy, slowing it down.

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.description: Hurl a fireball that sets an enemy alight.

iceblast.name: Iceblast
iceblast.description: Hurl a shard of ice that chills an enemy.

draft.name: Draft
draft.description: Blast a cross of tiles with wind pressure. It fans the flames: burning enemies burn longer, and fire on the ground spreads.

rain.name: Rain
rain.description: Call down rain on a 3x3 area for 3 turns. Anyone attacking from inside it hits weaker; walking through it chills the chilled further and dampens burning. Allies included.

sonic_boom.name: Sonic Boom
sonic_boom.description: Blast an enemy with wind and push it 2 tiles in the direction you choose. Being pushed out of an engagement or through fire and ice hurts as usual.

firestorm.name: Firestorm
firestorm.description: Cover a 3x3 area in a firestorm for 3 turns. Anyone moving through it or ending a turn in it burns.

blizzard.name: Blizzard
blizzard.description: Cover a 3x3 area in a snowstorm for 3 turns. Anyone moving through it or ending a turn in it is chilled, and can freeze.

cleanse.name: Cleanse
cleanse.description: Remove all debuffs from a unit.

protection.name: Protection
protection.description: Grant a unit Defense equal to 25% of your M.Atk for 3 turns.

barrier.name: Barrier
barrier.description: Grant a unit a shield equal to 80% of your M.Atk for 1 turn.

smite.name: Smite
smite.description: Strike a cross of tiles with holy light. Evil foes take double.

revelation.name: Revelation
revelation.description: Reveal every enemy within 15 tiles: they show through fog of war and lose Stealth until the end of their next turn.

engage.name: Engage
engage.description: Engage an adjacent enemy without attacking it.

charge.name: Charge
charge.description: Dash next to an enemy and strike it.

tough_it_out.name: Tough It Out
tough_it_out.description: Grit your teeth: gain a shield and shrug off every debuff until your next turn.

blitz.name: Blitz
blitz.description: Dash in and strike an enemy, then break away for free and dash at another one. No second strike if no other enemy can be reached.

fighting_spirit.name: Fighting Spirit
fighting_spirit.description: Whenever you become engaged with an enemy (whoever started it), you hit them with a free basic attack at 50% damage.

pocket_sand.name: Pocket Sand
pocket_sand.description: Throw sand in an enemy's eyes to blind it.

sucker_punch.name: Sucker Punch
sucker_punch.description: A Sudden and Deliberate Strike that knocks the wind out of an enemy: it loses an AP on its next turn.

tooth_for_tooth.name: Tooth for Tooth
tooth_for_tooth.description: When the enemy you're engaged with attacks you, you hit back with a free basic attack at 50% damage.

shadow_step.name: Shadow Step
shadow_step.description: Teleport a short distance and slip out of sight.

flicker_strike.name: Flicker Strike
flicker_strike.description: Teleport next to an enemy and strike it, leaving you an action.

backstab.name: Backstab
backstab.description: Strike the back of an enemy that is busy fighting someone else.

scout.name: Scout
scout.description: You start every battle Stealthed, and stay hidden until you first attack.

life_risking_strike.name: Life-Risking Strike
life_risking_strike.description: Drop your guard for a devastating strike. If the enemy survives, the blow hurts you too.

double_strike.name: Double Strike
double_strike.description: Hit an enemy with your basic attack twice, the second time at half strength.

execute.name: Execute
execute.description: Hit an enemy with your basic attack, dealing more damage the more Health it has lost.

power_strike.name: Power Strike
power_strike.description: A heavy blow with your weapon that carries through to whoever stands behind the target, allies included.

in_the_zone.name: In the Zone
in_the_zone.description: Focus: next turn, two of your basic attacks are free.

circle_swing.name: Circle Swing
circle_swing.description: Swing at every unit next to you, allies included, and knock them back.

circle_swing_spear.name: Circle Swing (Spear)
circle_swing_spear.description: Sweep the spear around you at a shorter reach but with more force, hitting every unit in reach, allies included, and knocking them back.

skills._monsters: Skills used only by monsters (see enemies.json). They are not in any skill tree.

sticky_spit.name: Sticky Spit
sticky_spit.description: Spit goo that slows an enemy and eats away its armor.

bite.name: Bite
bite.description: Bite an enemy and latch on.

pounce.name: Pounce
pounce.description: Leap next to an enemy and strike it.

howl.name: Howl
howl.description: Howl to rouse yourself and nearby allies.

war_cry.name: War Cry
war_cry.description: A battle cry that drives nearby allies into a frenzy.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.description: A wide swing that hits every enemy next to you.

poison_bite.name: Poison Bite
poison_bite.description: Sink venomous fangs into an adjacent enemy.

web.name: Web
web.description: Spit a sticky web that slows an enemy.

maul.name: Maul
maul.description: Swipe and grapple an adjacent enemy.

rend.name: Rend
rend.description: Tear into an adjacent enemy with both claws.

roar.name: Roar
roar.description: A terrifying roar that blinds nearby enemies with fear.

club.name: Club
club.description: Bash an adjacent enemy with a huge club.

smash.name: Smash
smash.description: A crushing overhead blow that sends an enemy flying.

regenerate.name: Regenerate
regenerate.description: Troll flesh knits itself back together.

wyvern_bite.name: Bite
wyvern_bite.description: Snap at an adjacent enemy and hold on.

dive.name: Dive
dive.description: Swoop down next to an enemy and strike it.

tail_sting.name: Tail Sting
tail_sting.description: Lash an adjacent enemy with a venomous tail.

spectral_touch.name: Spectral Touch
spectral_touch.description: A cold, grasping touch on an adjacent enemy.

chill_touch.name: Chill Touch
chill_touch.description: A freezing touch that drains warmth and chills an adjacent enemy.

wail.name: Wail
wail.description: A deathly wail that hurts and blinds every enemy nearby.

demon_claw.name: Claw
demon_claw.description: Rake an adjacent enemy with burning claws.

hellfire.name: Hellfire
hellfire.description: Hurl hellfire that sets an enemy ablaze.

infernal_leap.name: Infernal Leap
infernal_leap.description: Leap through the air to land next to an enemy and strike.
